name: finhub-harness
description: FinHub's harness factory: turns a domain description into an agent team, its skills and a surface-aware orchestrator, with an audited Authority List and mutation-tested QA. Skills: finhub-harness (full build), finhub-harness-light (low-token build and a light/full run switch), finhub-harness-evolve (folds run feedback back in). Ported from revfactory/harness v2.1.0 (Apache-2.0). The repo also ships the Master FinHub Python runtime.
